topics.description: There have been several recent cases of childcare scams, including a $2.76M scholarship scam in Baltimore and a massive childcare scam in Pennsylvania. These scams highlight the need for increased oversight and regulation in the childcare industry.

There have been several recent cases of ICE shootings, including a case in Minnesota where the state is suing the federal government for evidence. These cases highlight the need for increased transparency and accountability in ICE operations.
